Registrazione di Lavoro Non Ordinario

A maintenance log entry documenting unscheduled or unexpected technical issues or discrepancies detected during aircraft operations, requiring attention beyond regular or planned maintenance.

In this glossary, Registrazione di Lavoro Non Ordinario refers to: A maintenance log entry documenting unscheduled or unexpected technical issues or discrepancies detected during aircraft operations, requiring attention beyond regular or planned maintenance.

How is Registrazione di Lavoro Non Ordinario used in aviation?

Definition

A maintenance log entry documenting unscheduled or unexpected technical issues or discrepancies detected during aircraft operations, requiring attention beyond regular or planned maintenance.

Operational example

After landing, maintenance recorded a non-routine work entry for the right hydraulic system leak; corrective action is now required before next flight.
